blocks.text: By using the Zscaler AI Guard Service, you grant Zscaler the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify and display information from logs.
For AI Guard, logs are defined as the data collected in the form of prompts, responses, and other metadata.

Zscaler collects and stores metadata such as application name, policy triggered, and timestamp. If you opt in to the Store Prompt/Responses feature, the service will store end user prompts and prompt responses. If AI Guard is deployed as a proxy, LLM details will also be stored.
You have the option to encrypt the prompts and prompt responses using your organization’s encryption key.
Logs are stored for a period of 90 days. When your subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler according to the applicable retention cycles.
